risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattacks and security incidents that could result in costly damages, claims, expenses, reputational harm, competitive disadvantage, or operational disruption. Board oversight through NCG Committee with quarterly briefings on cybersecurity risks and incidents.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive markets where pricing and margin pressures could result from competing products and services.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Trade Risks
risks.score_rationale: US-China tariffs, trade sanctions, and rare earth mineral export restrictions could disrupt supply chain and increase costs. In 2025, significant new tariffs were implemented and retaliatory measures taken by multiple countries. China restricted exports of rare earth minerals used in company products.

risks.title: Restructuring Plans
risks.score_rationale: Company approved multiple restructuring plans (2023 Plan, 2025 Plan, Synergy Plan) resulting in significant charges and operational disruption. Fiscal 2025 charges totaled 177 million dollars combined. Actual timing and costs may differ materially from estimates.

risks.title: Asset Impairments
risks.score_rationale: Company recorded non-cash impairment charges of 85 million dollars in Q4 fiscal 2025 related to assets held-for-sale. Goodwill impairment risk exists if fair value determinations do not support carrying amounts due to cyclical business conditions.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Cyclical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in cyclical markets with exposure to fluctuations in customer demand, capital spending cycles, and general economic conditions. Downturns in customer demand, operational challenges, and adverse macroeconomic conditions could materially impact profitability.

ai_positioning.summary: Coherent is a significant beneficiary of AI datacenter buildouts. The company experienced stronger demand throughout fiscal 2025 in its Communications market driven by hyperscale and cloud customers building AI datacenters. Strong demand for datacenter transceivers and new ZR/ZR+ transceiver products directly supports the AI infrastructure buildout.
evidence: Increased number of hyperscale and cloud customers building AI datacenters drove demand for datacenter transceivers
Strong demand for new ZR/ZR+ transceiver products from AI datacenter customers
Growing demand for telecom transport products supporting AI datacenter infrastructure
Focus on display and semiconductor capital equipment within Industrial segment supporting AI chip manufacturing
